ITEM 1 | Bright green floret pieces with dense, bumpy tree-like crowns and pale green stalks, scattered across the bowl; crowns about 2-4 cm across, stalks about 1-2 cm thick, matte surface with no visible browning or char, sitting among the leaves | 85
ITEM 2 | Mixed loose salad leaves in varied greens and deep burgundy-purple tones, ruffled and flat-edged, some glossy, lightly moist, covering most of the bowl's inner surface in a loose tangle | 60
ITEM 3 | Thin, pale ivory shaved or shard-like flakes of hard cheese, irregular translucent slices about 2-4 cm long, dry-looking with slight granular edges, scattered over the greens and broccoli | 15
ITEM 4 | Small yellow crumbs or bits on the white surface beside the bowl, a few pale specks, dry and crumbly, not in the bowl | 1
ITEM 5 | Small pale green leaf fragment on the table surface below the bowl's left edge, flat and limp, about 1-2 cm | 1
